verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs provides a hosted MCP server and CLI/skill so an external assistant (e.g., Claude) can be delegated tasks like creating and managing agents via natural language, which supports agentic delegation for managing the product. However, this is delegation via an external LLM client connecting through MCP/CLI, not a built-in assistant embedded directly in the ElevenLabs dashboard UI itself. Missing for 10: evidence of a native in-product chat/copilot assistant embedded in the dashboard, and independent hands-on confirmation of this delegation workflow.
